**Not ready to publish.** Two claims aren't backed by the allowlist.

## Claims check

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "founded in Bristol in 2019" | Allowlisted |
| "small team of six" | Fine as written (team size is a product fact under the policy) |
| "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted |
| "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars" | **Unsupported.** The only rating we can back is 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. A 98% five-star figure is a new statistic, and it conflicts with the 4.8 average. |
| "we buy from gardens we've visited" | **Unsupported.** This is a claim about sourcing practice, not an origin or product fact, and nothing on the allowlist or in this chat supports it. If it's true, we need to know which gardens and who visited. |

## Suggested version

> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. Customers rate us 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. [PROOF NEEDED: which gardens the team has visited, and when]

If you can supply the garden visit details, I can write that line concretely. Otherwise, cut the sentence.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars", "type": "invented_stat"}, {"quote": "we buy from gardens we've visited", "type": "other"}], "publish": false}
```
